div.span: Unsaved changes: New, Open and Open recent ask Save, Discard or Cancel while the project is dirty (Escape cancels); Save continues only if it succeeds. Closing a window does not ask. Dirty means the sources, the tracked UI snapshot or the reports differ from the baseline.

text.tspan: Unsaved changes: New, Open and Open recent ask Save, Discard or Cancel while the project is
dirty (Escape cancels); Save continues only if it succeeds. Closing a window does not ask. Dirty
means the sources, the tracked UI snapshot or the reports differ from the baseline.

div.span: Save writes save_project as .imtz and sets the baseline to what was written; Save as goes through the picker and the overwrite guard. Opening fails with a message (cannot read, not a Debrief project, newer format, store locked) and leaves the state unchanged.

text.tspan: Save writes save_project as .imtz and sets the baseline to what was written; Save as goes through
the picker and the overwrite guard. Opening fails with a message (cannot read, not a Debrief
project, newer format, store locked) and leaves the state unchanged.
